theme_strategy.rationale: High-ticket enterprise B2B cold outreach engine ($100k agency grade). Dark cockpit mode provides high contrast data density for multi-inbox rotation telemetry, spam score gauge meters, and high-frequency delivery analytics without eye fatigue. Subtle electric cyan/emerald accents denote deliverability health.
theme_strategy.theme_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST / TACTICAL MINIMALISM (Performance Pro + Cyber Infrastructure)
theme_strategy.ai_slop_avoided: No generic purple-indigo gradients, no centered generic hero with floating isometric cards, no Inter headings. Instead: Sora variable display typography with tracking-tight, deep obsidian surface (#090D14) tinted with cool steel, high-precision telemetry grid lines (1px crisp borders at border-white/10), tactical deliverability health gauges (electric emerald #10B981, laser cyan #06B6D4, alert amber #F59E0B, hot crimson #EF4444), and editorial Swiss asymmetry.

items.title: Multi-Inbox Sender Rotation & Sending Health (0–100)
items.desc: Smartly load balances cold email bursts across all connected mailboxes. Automatically calculates 14-day bounce/reply curves and stops burning mailboxes before domains get blacklisted.

items.title: Live Spam Score Gauge & 1-Click Auto-Fixes
items.desc: Analyzes trigger words, link-to-text ratios, missing SPF/DKIM flags, and spintax entropy. Hard gates campaign launch until email copy is guaranteed inbox-ready.

items.title: Master Unified Inbox with AI Auto-Labels
items.desc: One unified stream for all domains. OpenAI categorizes replies instantly into Interested, Meeting Booked, Out of Office, or Wrong Person with automated follow-up halts.

items.title: Humanisation Pack & Dynamic Jitter Engine
items.desc: Plain-text mode, smart 'Re:' thread threading, randomized millisecond send gaps, timezone-aware business hour constraints, and custom preheaders.

items.title: Rewrite with AI & Spintax Multiplier
items.desc: Transform static pitches into 20+ spintax variants with customizable Tone, Goal, and Length parameters directly inside the step editor.

items.title: Follow-Up Priority Queue Slider
items.desc: Re-bias the scheduler queue dynamically between hunting new leads and closing high-intent follow-up steps with zero downtime.
